features.label: New Netherland
features.source: The Hudson between New Amsterdam and Fort Orange. Cliopatria has New Netherland at about 14,000 km² from 1626 and holding that shape until it took the Delaware.

features.name: New Netherland
features.label: New Netherland
features.source: Stuyvesant's conquest of New Sweden added the Delaware, taking New Netherland to about 28,000 km² before it surrendered to an English fleet in September 1664.

features.label: Dutch Guiana
features.source: Essequibo, Demerara and Berbice before British control was confirmed.

features.label: Suriname (Netherlands)
features.source: Dutch Guiana, later Suriname; represented with its modern boundary.

features.label: Dutch Caribbean
features.source: Held since the 1630s, apart from short British occupations during the Napoleonic wars, which are too brief to draw.
